new_results: Every admissible marginal is L1-approximable by compactly supported C-infinity probability densities with the exact cap <=1 and no uniform support/moment bound.
Product and quadratic-pushforward total variation is at most one half the sum of marginal L1 errors.
The optimal full QFORM small-ball constant equals the optimal constant on compact finite-fragment indicators and on compactly supported smooth product densities.
Any strict counterexample to a proposed universal constant transfers to smooth compact product laws with the same matrix and violating interval.

Selective localization: after choosing an active original-coordinate set from A, only inactive coordinates need be extremized/localized; a deterministic-outside active small-ball bound transfers with exactly the same constant.

Therefore all-coordinate DAD weighted-congruence loss is avoidable for original-coordinate definite-pair and regularized cross-block mechanisms whose conditional estimates are uniform in outside affine/self phases.
continuity_status: OPEN_SEPARATE; the L-infinity localization equivalence does not by itself transfer continuity without a uniform modulus or another continuity-stability theorem.
